notes.title: Update Status
notes.content:
Well well well, it's been a while hasn't it.
In fact well over a year since the last news!

But I am here today to tell you this project is still being worked on!
It's still going to take a while before I can release an update, but that's because I've [strike]broken everything[/strike] been pushing the game engine to it's limits!

With the lighting overhaul from the last announcement, I wanted to also improve other aspect of the games visuals an audio.

Did you know that lighting doesn't work too well when going diagonally? Turns out that was a rather interesting visual! 
But I got that fixed! 

Additionally I wanted to make ambient sounds more immersive. So... after much trial and error I sounds to be location based... sort of. They just get louder the closer you are. I never managed to get them to be directional.

Up Next we have messages! They will now no longer be a boring box at the bottom of the screen, but will now show above the character that's talking, which is also very useful to know which character is talking in scenes. 

Additionally, I've been looking back over the reviews and posts to identify other areas that needed fixing up.

A common complaint was the battle system being too fast. Now, we do have the "Wait" battle mode that does address this, but I will also be looking at balancing the battles to make it so playing on Semi-Active and Full Active are not a constant barrage of actions so you as the player can have time to think and act on whats going on.

If you have any suggestions or other feedback please let me know in the comments!

notes.title: Changes to expect in the next update(s)
notes.content:
So, news… lets give you some of that.
As well as working on the update I will also be redoing most of the events in the game.
Expect the following changes (Although some may come sooner than others)

-	I Probably won’t need to say this but. More Story! 
-	Spelling fixes… I hope (I wish RPG Maker had spell checker) 
-	Changes to NPC Interaction in some early areas.
-	Improvements to the main story “These shouldn’t need you to start a new game, but will provide more flavour text to the main game and be done as part of the NPS changes”
-	Enemy Balancing
-	Skill Balancing 
-	Introduction of “Extreme” Difficulty Option. 

I also plan to add more advanced mechanics, but if they require you to start a new game they won’t be added until a transition from Early Access to Full Release, I will look to add a “Legacy Version” that will be the previous build without the features, It will be unsupported, except for Bug Fixes, (expect this after the main story has been finished)

These changes will start come in the R16X builds (R160 to R169)

notes.title: Upcoming Mini-Patch
notes.content:
This weekend a mini-patch will be released.

Here are a few thanks that will change:

Battles:

- Some enemies will have their speed and defense reduced

- Stun rate will be reduced for Bodyslam

- Dark Rat's will have their HP Reduced 

- Some enemies will have their attacked boosted to make up for the speed loss.

- Some bosses will have their ATK/MAT Reduced and their DEF/MDF boosted

- Most Bosses will have new skills added that will be used later in the battle

- Encounter Rate will be reduced is some areas

- ManaHype will be a rare drop for all Slime forms (1/16 chance)

NPC's/Animals

 - New NPC's will be added to some areas to add flavor text/lore

 - Some NPC's have their speed setting set to max. This was an FPS Debug test and will be reduced.

- Move Routes will be changed for some animals as they can block the player in some areas.

Items:

- Potions will now only recover 150 HP

- Magic Water will restore 100MP

- ManaHype will be added into earlier areas as a rare find

notes.title: What will happen in the story in the next update?
notes.content:
So the next update is staring to look amazing, so I thought I would let you know where the story will go next!

As you exit the Inn that you end up in after battling the dragon a new cut scene will take place, after this the game will shift from Mike back to Sophie. From this point it will just be Sophie in the party, All items in Mike's Party will not be available (With the exception of the Quest book) and Sophie will only have the gear she had when the party was split back at the Sand Tower.

That's all for now!
